Quick Start Guide
Zentra ZX-110 DOCSIS 3.1 Cable Modem

WHAT YOU NEED
- Coaxial cable connected to an active cable outlet
- Computer with an Ethernet port

INSTALLATION
1. Connect the coaxial cable to the Cable port on the modem.
2. Connect the Ethernet cable from the modem to your computer.
3. Plug in the power adapter and press the power button.
4. Wait for the Online light to turn solid white. This can take up to 10 minutes.
5. Call your provider to activate the modem with the MAC address on the label.

TROUBLESHOOTING
Open a web browser and go to 192.168.100.1 to view the modem status page.
